name: Learn a language
summary: Learn a language with a daily practice mix and regular speaking sessions, paced to your level and any trip date.

onboarding.reaction: Short daily practice beats long weekly cramming.

onboarding.prompt: Tap your practice slot and a weekly speaking slot.

phases.name: Basics
actions: Daily mix: words, listening, speaking aloud

plan_blueprint.calendar: A daily practice block and a weekly speaking session; travel phrases are moved up if a trip date is set.

approach_variants.habit: Practice stacked on a daily routine (commute, lunch); streak of practice days.
approach_variants.willpower: Monthly speaking challenge and a countdown to the trip or deadline.
approach_variants.time: Daily practice and weekly speaking sessions as calendar blocks; weekly minutes review.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen reward at each level milestone.
approach_variants.resource: First week gathers an app, a tutor or exchange partner, and a notebook.

guardrails: Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
Product, app or recipe ideas are labeled as suggestions; any affiliate link is disclosed.
restart_rules: A missed day is skipped. After a missed week, the plan starts with a review day before adding new material.

price_log.basis: Launch proposal per docs/MARKETPLACE.md; pending owner approval
